data.name: Import_ArtlistCueSheetMissing
data.value: No Artlist cue sheet found, so the authors are missing. Download it (Artlist > Downloads > Song License > Cue sheet) and drop it onto the list.

data.name: Import_AudioUnreadable
data.value: The audio file could not be read.

data.name: Import_NoSource
data.value: No music source recognised this file.

data.name: Import_SidecarUnmatched
data.value: Matches none of the new files or of the lines in the list.

data.name: Info_Autori
data.value: Composers and lyricists, never the performers. RAI passes them on to SIAE, which pays them. Write "Nome Cognome; Nome Cognome" or "Cognome, Nome; Cognome, Nome".

data.name: Info_DataRegistrazione
data.value: Date of the recording. If it is empty, the date five days before the broadcast is sent.

data.name: Info_Durata
data.value: Durata Tx.: length of the broadcast, hh:mm:ss.

data.name: Info_Edizione
data.value: Music publisher. RAI only accepts publishers it knows, so leave it empty when in doubt. Empty for musicmedia and Artlist.

data.name: Info_FormOnly
data.value: Only printed on the Word form, not uploaded to RAI.

data.name: Info_Genere
data.value: Genere SIAE: ML musica leggera: light and popular music, the usual value MC musica classica: classical music DO DOR: drama and theatre works LI lirica: opera OL OLAF: literary works and visual arts CI cinema Placeholder – to be confirmed: whether RAI's web form accepts all of them.

data.name: Info_LineDurata
data.value: Length actually used on air, hh:mm:ss. It must be consistent with the programme's Durata.

data.name: Info_Marca
data.value: Label of the recording. RAI only accepts labels from its own list; the app warns about others. musicmedia partner labels: "Sonoton". Artlist: "ARTLIST".

data.name: Info_OraInizio
data.value: Ora inizio and Ora fine: start and end of the broadcast. When they differ, RAI computes Durata Tx. from them.

data.name: Info_Puntata
data.value: Episode number. RAI only accepts episodes that exist for this Uorg/Matricola in its programme registry (Anagrafica Programmi).

data.name: Info_Rete
data.value: Channel or structure, TV1 to TV4. The Tipo generazione values RAI offers depend on it.

data.name: Info_Ruolo
data.value: How the music is used: SF sottofondo: background, the usual value PP primo piano: featured, the music is in the foreground SI sigla: opening or closing theme

data.name: Info_Sede
data.value: The RAI office that commissions the programme: BZ/16 Bolzano, German programmes BZ/14 Bolzano, Italian programmes BZ/15 Bolzano, Ladin programmes Sede and Rete decide who verifies and approves the DCP at RAI.

data.name: Info_Serie
data.value: Series number, sent to RAI as three digits (001). Placeholder – to be confirmed: further details.

data.name: Info_SiglaNum
data.value: Catalogue code of the recording, e.g. SCDV 579 or MSC192.

data.name: Info_TipoGenerazione
data.value: 9 opera su disco: recorded music, the usual value 1 dal vivo: performed live Placeholder – to be confirmed: the other values RAI offers for each Rete.

data.name: Info_TitoloItaliano
data.value: Title of the programme in Italian.

data.name: Info_TitoloOriginale
data.value: Title of the programme in its original language.

data.name: Info_UorgMatricola
data.value: Uorg and Matricola are RAI's internal codes of the production: the organisational unit and the programme number. They come from the contract or from RAI. Placeholder – to be confirmed: where exactly to find them.
